go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Username

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "string",
  "minLength": 3,
  "maxLength": 12
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/userpkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestUsername_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`"alice"`)
	var u Username
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &u); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if u != "alice" {
		t.Errorf("Unmarshal = %q, want %q", string(u), "alice")
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(u)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `"alice"` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, `"alice"`)
	}
}

func TestUsername_TooShort(t *testing.T) {
	var u Username
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"hi"`), &u)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want minLength rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "below minimum 3") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want minimum-length message", err)
	}
}

func TestUsername_TooLong(t *testing.T) {
	var u Username
	err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`"abcdefghijklmnop"`), &u)
	if err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want maxLength rejection")
	}
	if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "above maximum 12") {
		t.Errorf("err = %q, want maximum-length message", err)
	}
}
